name: The Shadow Of The Bequest
source:
Imagine spending your entire life at an all-boys boarding school, with barely any experience interacting with girls.

Then, one day, you learn that your father has died.

When you return home, you discover that inheriting his estate won't be quite as simple as you expected. There are some rather unusual conditions you'll have to meet before you can claim what he left behind.

But that's not all.

Along with the inheritance comes an entire house full of girls and women — people you now have to live with under the same roof, despite having almost no idea how to deal with them.

A new life, strange rules, family secrets, and a house full of people you were never prepared to understand.

[From [url=https://nikoyho.itch.io/tsotb]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
试想一下，你从小到大都就读于全封闭寄宿男校，几乎没有任何与女性打交道的经验。

然后某一天，你得知父亲去世了。

当你回到家中才发现，继承他的遗产远没有想象中那么简单。在正式接手他留下的家业之前，你必须先满足几个相当离奇的条件。

但这还不是全部。

随这份遗产一同到来的，还有整整一屋子的少女与成熟女性——尽管你对如何与女性相处几乎一窍不通，如今却不得不和她们在同一屋檐下共同生活。

全新的生活、古怪的规矩、家族的秘密，以及一屋子你从未做好准备去理解的女性。

[摘自[url=https://nikoyho.itch.io/tsotb]itch.io[/url]]
